'''John Sarnecki''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 7 from Munster, In. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

== Squadron listing ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Slot !! Town !! Status (fan table)
|-
| Gold 7 || Munster, In || Retired
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.

== Anagrams ==

A GeoCities fan page (copied onto Encyclopedia 3.2 p.200) maps these printed titles:

* [[Corporal Kensaric]] — John Sarnecki, Gold 7

== Other sourced notes ==

Gold 7, Munster, Indiana. The anagram list unscrambles [[Corporal Kensaric]] as John Sarnecki.

The original GeoCities Corellian Engineering home (Wayback 13 May 2001) says former Squadron Member John Sarnecki introduced Indiana and Illinois to the King of Corellia tournament, which went on hiatus after his retirement and returned 2 September (Labor Day weekend) in Carmel, Indiana.<ref name="geo2001">[https://web.archive.org/web/20010513005725/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/ Original GeoCities home], 13 May 2001 (Wayback)</ref>
